generationRequest.prompt: Use case: edit reference background into ONE isolated transparent FAR ORGAN PARALLAX LAYER for a 2D side-scrolling underwater game inside a dead whale. Preserve reference matte painted gouache style and organ identity. Output landscape16:9 canvas, keep original 1672x941 aspect and composition anchors. This layer contains only 1 or 2 broad perimeter anatomical contours as a single layer, with a large completely transparent center and lower center for gameplay. REMOVE ALL blue water, water rays, bubbles, specks, haze, background wash, floor platforms, near framing, creatures and all props. All empty areas must have genuine zero-alpha transparency, no blue rectangle, no checker pattern. Keep far anatomy muted cool low contrast with soft internal shading but a clean external alpha edge. No bright top ledges that read as gameplay terrain, no cropped gameplay modules. Depict only the following far organ forms: One distant chain of whale vertebrae EXTERNAL lateral surfaces receding from upper LEFT toward upper RIGHT, on a broad diagonal along upper third, and at most a few anterior rib remnants only at far left. Absolutely no ribs near the right/tail end and never an inside-spinal-canal tunnel. Dark muted blue-gray old bone, not bright ivory gameplay ledges. Keep central and lower two-thirds mostly transparent. No loose nearby bone, walkway, coral or tissue bottom border. Remove all blue water in between and below.
